about_the_game:
In the near future, a large number of Zergs and Zerg overlords suddenly pour in from an unknown parallel universe and start to erode various galaxies in this universe. Their technological level is far higher than that of this universe. The powerful unknown technology makes many galaxies fall one after another. It is not until humans analyze and apply the powerful skills of these Zerg overlords that they begin to fight back.

Game Features

· Diverse weapon, skill, and module (item) combinations to form your own unique build

· Unique skill design, no homogenized skills

· Multiple gameplay modes, catering to both roguelike and arcade players

· Skill effects vary in different modes, balancing skill performance in different modes

· All arcade mode content unlocked, take on the challenge of the world leaderboard

· A variety of Zerg skills, randomly designated boss at the start of the game, players formulate pre-battle strategies based on the boss

· Out-of-game aircraft improvement system, permanently enhance the skill effects of the fighter aircraft

name: Galaxy Frame

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe / Nvidia GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 (Adrenalin 22.1.2)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 3.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 / AMD RX 570 (Adrenalin 22.1.2)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Galaxy Frame is a space Roguelite game players control their aircraft to survive the attacks of alien insects. By understanding the characteristics of aircraft, skills, and props, players can build their own decks and challenge stronger enemies. Arcade mode to challenge the world leaderboard.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
